channel.title: Kitchen Buyer's Desk
channel.description: Guides and listing facts for air fryers, ovens and meat thermometers

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two shapes, two different kitchens. Start with the cooking you do most and the space you have.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity is printed in several units. Compare them the same way before you decide.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Every appliance takes up space and needs cleaning. Measure both before you pay.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: One box that air fries, bakes, toasts and dehydrates can replace several. It can also replace none of them well.

item.title: Which questions matter before you buy a digital meat thermometer?
item.description: Accuracy, response time, probes and waterproofing are printed in different places. Find each one before you compare.
